claim_scope: Offline transpilation only. No QPU execution, no shots, no QPU time consumed.
question: Is the ISA depth 8->7 difference between the two ibm_fez runs caused by optimization level or by the physical qubit pair?

method.backend_source: QiskitRuntimeService.backend() metadata fetch; no job submitted

finding: For this Bell circuit, backend snapshot, and tested layouts, ISA depth and size varied only with optimization level. Depth was 8 at level 1 and 7 at level 3 for every layout tested, with zero variance across 10 transpiler seeds.
limitations: Establishes the cause of the depth/size difference only. It says nothing about the measured correlation difference between the two hardware runs, which remains confounded and statistically insignificant.
Depth was deterministic across the 10 seeds tested; it is not a proof of determinism for all seeds or all backend calibration snapshots.
Backend coupling map and basis gates were read at run time and may differ from those in effect during the original hardware jobs.
